Meghalaya Tourism calls Mawlynnong Asia's cleanest village and God's Own Garden. It sits in East Khasi Hills, about 76 km from Shillong, near the Bangladesh border.
The Nohwet living-root bridge is woven from Ficus elastica roots over generations, a Khasi practice the state tourism guide highlights in the village.
Shared sumos leave Shillong for Pynursla; local cabs cover the last stretch. The state guide puts Shillong Airport about 103 km away.
The state tourism page says Mawlynnong can be visited year-round, with post-monsoon and winter easier for being outdoors.
A bamboo sky viewpoint in the village looks over the Bangladesh plains, a short walk from the single-decker root bridge.
